Provenance of the NFAg test files in this folder

nfag.xml
  Written from scratch following the XSD (nfag_v1.00.xsd / nfagTiposBasico_v1.00.xsd, package NT2026.002 RTC 1.01).
  No sample was copied. All data is fictitious: CNPJ 99999999000191, CPF 12345678909, test names/addresses,
  example.com e-mails, tpAmb 2, mod 75; access key with valid mod 11 cDV; qrCodNFAg matching the pattern.
- appended a dummy, structurally valid ICP-Brasil xmldsig <Signature> (fixed c14n/rsa-sha1/sha1 algorithm URIs, Reference URI="#<Id>", dummy base64 DigestValue/SignatureValue/X509Certificate; no real certificate)

nfag-proc.xml
  Built from nfag.xml wrapped into <nfagProc versao="1.00"> plus a synthetic <protNFAg versao="1.00">
- protocol (infProt) is synthetic: tpAmb 2, verAplic SVRS-TESTE-1.0, dummy nProt/digVal, cStat 100, xMotivo "Autorizado o uso da NFAg"
